scripts.translation:
[学者]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
It takes a lifetime...
Literally a lifetime
to amass the knowledge
necessary to become
a Scholar...
scripts.translation:
[学者]
这需要一生的时间……
字面意义上的一生，
才能积累成为学者
所必需的知识……

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
It's overwhelming.
The more you learn, the
more you discover what
else you don't know.
There's no end to the
process of learning...
scripts.translation:
[学者]
这令人感到敬畏。
你学得越多，就越会发现
自己还有多少不知道的东西。
学习的过程永无止境……

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Midgard doesn't
have enough Scholars to
help usher in a new age
of prosperity. The
world needs you...
scripts.translation:
[学者]
米德加尔特没有足够的学者
来 usher in 一个繁荣的新时代。
世界需要你……

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Will you take this
awesome responsibility?
Will you serve Midgard
as a Scholar?
scripts.translation:
[学者]
你愿意承担
这份重大的责任吗？
你愿意作为学者
为米德加尔特服务吗？

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[学者]
当你准备好时，
随时可以回来。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
你仍然可以学习更多的技能。请在回到我这里之前，用完所有剩余的技能点。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Congratulations!
As a Professor, I hope
that you will take an
active part in bringing
the light of knowledge
where there is darkness.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
恭喜！
作为一名智者，我希望
你能积极参与，
将知识之光带到
黑暗之处。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
欢迎来到
瓦尔哈拉，
荣誉之殿。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[学者]
请在这里
随意放松。
向勇士们致敬！
